column2: AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE FREE NURSERY AND WELFARE COMPLEX

column1: WHEREAS an Association called and known as the “Free
Nursery  and  Welfare  Complex”  has  heretofore  been
established  in  Sri  Lanka,  for  the  purpose  of  effectually
carrying out and transacting all objects and matters connected
with the said association according to the rules agreed to by
its members :
AND  WHEREAS  the  said  association  has  heretofore
successfully  carried  out  and  transacted  several  objects  and
matters  for  which  it  was  established  and  has  applied  to  be
incorporated and it will be for the public advantage to grant
such application :
BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Free Nursery and Welfare

column1: Complex (Incorporation) Act, No. 31 of 2009.

column2: From and after the date of commencement of this Act,

column1: such and so many persons as presently are members of the
Free Nursery and Welfare Complex (hereinafter referred to as
the “Complex”) or shall hereafter be admitted members of
the Corporation hereby constituted shall be a body corporate
with perpetual succession under the name and  style of the
“Free Nursery and Welfare Complex” (hereinafter referred to
as the “Corporation”) and by that name may sue and be sued
in all Courts, with full power and authority to have and use a
common seal, and alter the same at its pleasure.
